verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents settlement mechanics (charge-token API, committed amounts, wallet-to-wallet fund movement, charge windows up to 24h post-expiry, settlement up to 51h) that give merchants a payout trail, and wallets/tokens are per-agent and auditable via introspect-token. However there is no documented merchant-facing reporting/reconciliation dashboard, no statement/ledger export, no mention of standard accounting integrations (invoices, CSV/API exports for bookkeeping), and no independent evidence of real-world reconciliation workflows. missing for 10: dedicated payout/statement reporting docs, ledger/export or accounting-system integration, third-party confirmation of reconciliation in practice.
